gates.unit: node --test tests/battle-south.test.mjs, tests/south-map.test.mjs, tests/battle-view-south.test.mjs: the named test and no other

unit.name: a recall reaches a man already in the fight, or dead or taken before the word
unit.expect: nobody can be sent for once the fight begins, and the refusal says nothing of what became of them
failed: nobody can be sent for once the fight begins, and the refusal says nothing of what became of them

unit.name: a man's fate lands the moment the fight is armed, not at its staged moment
unit.expect: each man's fate is the roll it always was, lands at its own moment inside the fight, and is on no screen and in no report before
failed: each man's fate is the roll it always was, lands at its own moment inside the fight, and is on no screen and in no report before

unit.name: a man's fate is sent to his family's page before it happens
unit.expect: each man's fate is the roll it always was, lands at its own moment inside the fight, and is on no screen and in no report before
failed: each man's fate is the roll it always was, lands at its own moment inside the fight, and is on no screen and in no report before

unit.name: Agua Dulce kept at six in the morning
unit.expect: San Patricio is fought at three in the morning of February 27, Agua Dulce at half past ten on March 2, and the day never moves
failed: San Patricio is fought at three in the morning of February 27, Agua Dulce at half past ten on March 2, and the day never moves

unit.name: the men are put in the force only after the first shot
unit.expect: a man sent south is at San Patricio, and in the force before the first shot, or rides with Grant and drives the horses north
failed: a man sent south is at San Patricio, and in the force before the first shot, or rides with Grant and drives the horses north

unit.name: every family is sent the fight, whether it has a man there or not
unit.expect: the Host sees each fight live and is framed on it; a family with a man there sees it and is alerted; a family with nobody there is sent nothing
failed: the Host sees each fight live and is framed on it; a family with a man there sees it and is alerted; a family with nobody there is sent nothing

failed: the join is refused, in words, once a man could not reach San Patricio before the raid, and offered before

unit.name: the woods end at the box, so San Patricio stands on no ground

failed: the land the simulation reads runs on below the box to 27.6°N, on the box's own lattice, and the box is untouched
